Copy a source's schemas into a different Postgres database

Source: R/extend.R
clone_source_to_db.Rd

General-purpose clone: works for any source and any pair of databases, whatever they're actually named - it just copies whichever of the source's schemas you ask for from from_db to to_db. Creates the target database if it does not exist, then copies every table from each requested schema using pg_dump | pg_restore via system calls (requires pg_dump in PATH). This is the correct approach when you want full isolation: a colleague can connect to the target project database without touching the source database at all.

Usage

clone_source_to_db(
  src_name,
  from_db,
  to_db,
  creds,
  schemas = c("raw", "concepts", "derived", "harmonized"),
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

src_name

Source name (e.g. "mimic_iv_demo").

from_db

Source database name - whatever your project's database is actually called (e.g. "rendehr" is just the common default when nothing overrides it; see .ehr_resolve_db_name()). Not tied to any specific name - pass whatever database you're actually copying from.

to_db

Target database name. Created if it does not exist.

creds

List from load_credentials(). Same credentials used for both.

schemas

Which schemas to copy, as keys of src_schema_names(). Default: all four of the source's schemas (raw, concepts, derived, harmonized). "ts", "flat" and "dur" are accepted and resolve to the harmonized schema that holds those tables.

overwrite

Drop and recreate schemas in the target. Default FALSE.

Value

The name of the target database, invisibly.

Details

Alternatively, just point run_one_source() at a different db_name from the start - that is the simplest way to build an isolated project database.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
creds <- load_credentials("config/config_pass.json")

# "rendehrdov" below is just an example database name (a hypothetical dev
# database), not a requirement - substitute whatever from_db actually is.
clone_source_to_db("mimic_iv_demo",
                   from_db  = "rendehrdov",
                   to_db    = "project_rehab",
                   creds    = creds,
                   schemas  = c("raw", "concepts", "harmonized"))

# Now connect to the isolated project DB
ehr_connect("project_rehab", creds)
fetch_concept("mimic_iv_demo", "heart_rate")
} # }
